page.layout: One page of text, centred: title block, a list of four books, an engraved vignette, then the imprint and date. No running head, page number or catchword.
page.notes: Engraving between the book list and the imprint: a small vignette showing a face or mask within laurel branches, with scrolls and a bordered oval base below. Handwritten "1" at the top right corner and a handwritten mark below the imprint are not printed and are left out. Faint show-through of text from the reverse page is visible in the lower half and is left out. The date is printed with a reversed-C M and an ordinary M, transcribed as MDXC. The title-page lines are set in small capitals and italic; the spelling of the printed u/v forms (SELECTORVM, CARMINVM, COLLECTORVM, QVATVOR, GVISIACA) is normalised as the rules require.
